name: postiz
title_zh: 28 个平台共用一张排期表，发帖前先问你要不要改
tagline_zh: X、Reddit、Telegram、WordPress 全挤在一个日历里。拖一下就是跨平台定时。
tagline_en: X, Reddit, Telegram, WordPress in one calendar. Drag to schedule everywhere, and it pauses: 'Sure this fits.
desc_en: Postiz is a tool to schedule social media and chat posts to 28+ channels X, LinkedIn, LinkedIn Page, Reddit, Instagram, Facebook Page, Threads, YouTube, Google My Business, TikTok, Pinterest, Dribbble, Discord, Slack, Kick, Twitch, Mastodon, Bluesky, Lemmy, Farcaster, Telegram, Nostr, VK, Medium, Dev.to, Hashnode, WordPress, ListMonk
why_zh: 不是简单转发器——每个渠道单独排队，改一处不影响其他。自带内容建议，像有个懂各平台脾气的助理在帮你分流。
why_en: Not a blunt broadcaster—each channel queues separately, edits stay local. Built-in suggestions act like an assistant who knows.
limit_zh: 只做排期与发布，不含内容生成、数据分析或评论区管理。需要自备各平台 API 密钥；免费版有渠道数上限，超出要付费。
limit_en: Scheduling and posting only—no content generation, analytics, or comment moderation. Requires your own API keys per platform; free tier caps.
title_en: One schedule for 28 channels, asks before posting
